failure_signal: case closed but household lacks stable housing, medicine, food, utilities, income, school, or documents
minimum_ready_test: closure reason, outcome status, unresolved need, and reopen route are public in aggregate and correctable

failure_signal: missed payments, collections, asset sale, repossession, foreclosure, high-cost debt
minimum_ready_test: forbearance, credit-code/correction, debt hold, emergency cash, insurance advance, and complaint route are sequenced

failure_signal: renter cannot return or afford repaired unit, eviction filings rise, landlord controls repair access
minimum_ready_test: tenant notice, right-to-return, habitability, rent-change watch, fair-housing review, and legal-aid referral are active

failure_signal: job/self-employment interruption hidden inside debt, unsafe return, no childcare or transport
minimum_ready_test: DUA or wage support, reemployment, safe-work remedy, childcare, and transport are linked

failure_signal: household cannot reach jobs, school, clinic, benefits, food, or repair despite open roads
minimum_ready_test: critical recovery trips are mapped and served via transit, paratransit, mobile services, fuel/charging, or vouchers

failure_signal: habitable structure lacks appliances, devices, refrigeration, DME, communications, or school/work tools
minimum_ready_test: functional item categories are repaired, replaced, loaned, delivered, or substituted with appeal path

failure_signal: lost phone, documents, email, SIM, or MFA blocks applications/status/appeals
minimum_ready_test: document recovery, MFA fallback, in-person proofing, trusted-referee path, and offline application/status exist

failure_signal: program closes before residual risk, maintenance, mitigation, or unresolved needs are owned
minimum_ready_test: closeout report ties outcomes, residual risk, unresolved needs, budgets, mitigation, standards, and reopen rules
